title: Chapter 7 Summary: Madam Rides the Bus

body: Valli is an eight-year-old girl who saves money to ride the bus to the city. She sees a dead cow by the road and realises that life and death are part of a cycle. The story captures childhood curiosity and the sudden awareness of mortality.
